description: Source code for managing Lua-based upgrade system in the Unvanquished game, including classes, methods, and Lua bindings for upgrade proxies and upgrade collections.

classes.name: UpgradeProxy
classes.description: Proxy class representing an upgrade, providing Lua-accessible getters for upgrade attributes.

classes.name: Upgrades
classes.description: Collection class managing multiple UpgradeProxy instances and Lua bindings for upgrade operations.

methods.description: Lua __pairs metamethod to iterate over all upgrades.
